channel.title: USA AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of US political, economic and security developments

item.title: DOJ defends White House media ban, urges court to reject lawsuit
item.description: The Department of Justice defended President Trump's recent media ban, arguing that reporting by CNN, MS Now and Politico on a wide range of issues jeopardized national security and spread falsehoods.

item.title: Major news outlets banned by Trump will have their day in court
item.description: CNN, MS NOW, and Politico are asking a federal judge to hold the president in check for what they say is a violation of their Constitutional rights simply because he doesn't like how they cover him.

item.title: There's growing concern that Trump may deploy the National Guard ahead of elections
item.description: Fears are growing that President Trump may deploy the U.S. military to polling places in the upcoming elections, despite strict state and federal laws against such a move.

item.title: As Congress confronts AI, Senate lawmakers are shut off from its most advanced tools
item.description: While Senate offices have access to chatbots like ChatGPT, they are not authorized to use any of the more advanced tools that are at the center of regulatory talks and public debate about AI safety.

item.title: Poll: Trust in the U.S. Postal Service delivering mail-in ballots on time has fallen
item.description: Registered voters are less confident that USPS will deliver election mail on time compared with 2024, an NPR/PBS News/Marist poll finds, after USPS was part of Trump's bid to limit mail voting.

item.title: ICE is looking into 'mobile detention facilities'
item.description: Buried in the paperwork for Immigration and Customs Enforcement's expansion in Pennsylvania is a document requesting "mobile detention facilities."

item.title: Poll: Most voters agree the 2026 midterms are all about Trump — and they disapprove
item.description: A new NPR/PBS News/Marist poll finds President Trump — and his unpopularity — is an outsize factor in why most voters say they want Democrats to win the midterms.

item.title: Category 5 Hurricane Polo is 'one of the strongest storms ever'
item.description: Hurricane Polo has grown into one of the most powerful Pacific cyclones in decades, and it was expected to skirt Mexico's southwestern coast as a Category 5 storm.

item.title: China’s Xi set to arrive in Washington for high-stakes Trump summit as AI supremacy battle looms large
item.description: China's President Xi Jinping arrives for a tense White House summit with Trump covering AI, tariffs, rare earth minerals, and fentanyl exports.

item.title: Karoline Leavitt says some White House reporters privately apologized for asking 'unfair' questions
item.description: Karoline Leavitt says White House reporters privately apologized for asking questions their bosses demanded, calling them 'unfair' during briefings.

item.title: Trump embraced a socialist he’s told voters to fear. Republicans aren’t thrilled
item.description: Trump praised Zohran Mamdani weeks after calling Democrats "communists," leaving GOP strategists frustrated ahead of the critical midterm election.

item.title: Zelenskyy to seek offramp for years-long Russia war in UN speech after Trump reveals peace deal is close
item.description: Volodymyr Zelenskyy addresses the United Nations General Assembly with security proposals as Trump presses for a faster Russia Ukraine war deal.

item.title: Supreme Court can restore sanity and stop the left’s radical climate agenda
item.description: The Supreme Court's Suncor v. Boulder case could determine whether cities or Congress control carbon emissions regulation and U.S. energy policy.

item.title: What the golf cart industry can teach us about China’s threat to American jobs
item.description: Club Car and E-Z-GO face a major surge in Chinese golf cart imports backed by subsidies as Trump prepares to meet Xi Jinping in Washington, D.C.

item.title: Texas man charged with capital murder after 5-year-old killed in roadway shooting
item.description: Jeremy Porter was charged with capital murder after police said he killed 5-year-old Zah'Layah Walter in a roadway shooting in northwest Harris County.

item.title: Harris keeps 2028 door open as she hits midterm campaign trail, warns ‘28 won’t matter’ without 2026
item.description: Kamala Harris told Detroit voters she has not decided on a 2028 presidential run, stressing that the 2026 midterm elections must come first.

item.title: ‘I am the code’: Trump clashed with ballroom architect over safety issues
item.description: James McCrery II resigned in October after warning that the president was insisting on designs that violated fire and safety codes.

item.title: ICE officer in Texas shooting was recruit not using a body camera
item.description: The officer joined ICE last year during the agency’s hiring spree. DHS is facing mounting scrutiny over how the recruits were vetted and trained.

item.title: Senate Armed Services Committee chair criticizes Trump-Xi meeting
item.description: Republican Sen. Roger Wicker says he disagrees with the “lavish welcome” planned for the Chinese leader, whom he calls an “oppressive dictator.”

item.title: Man convicted of shooting Palestinian students in U.S. after Oct. 7 attack
item.description: Jason Eaton pursued an insanity defense in the 2023 shooting in Vermont, which spread fear through Arab and Muslim communities in the United States.
